name: Atlanta
//bbox: lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max — the study area for REGISTRY I acquisition.
//tiles: The OSM Notes API caps results per request. Split the bbox into this many columns × rows so a dense city is not silently truncated. Raised from 4×4 after a run reported a tile AT LIMIT over the Beltline corridor — if the ingester warns, raise these before trusting the corpus.
//query: closed_days: -1 keeps resolved notes in the corpus. A closed note is not a non-event — it is testimony that was acted on, and its status travels with every claim.
//institutional: REGISTRY II. The bodies whose minutes are the corpus, and where their calendars live. Filling these in is what makes a second city real rather than sketched.
//note: Grid and gazetteer for REGISTRY II live in halfworld/world.config.json — a second city forks that file, not this one. This file is what REGISTRY I acquisition needs.
